  "description": "Easy. Quick. Delicious. Simplify busy days with Smucker’s Uncrustables — the easiest kid-approved snacks and lunch foods ever. Or, store them in the freezer for longer and thaw whenever you’re ready. No fuss. No crust. It’s just The Best Part of the Sandwich, with the yummiest tastes and textures. Each Uncrustables Peanut Butter Sandwich is made with Unbeatably Soft Bread Baked Fresh in the USA, and packed with 30% more peanut butter than our regular 2-oz. Peanut Butter & Grape Jelly Sandwich — a deliciously creamy dream-come-true for peanut butter lovers. They also contain no high fructose corn syrup and no artificial colors or dyes.
